rule: All field jobs share one schedule. CEP-5 only when the job is an Alabama OSS install or repair. Out-of-state OSS jobs are schedule-only until a later form pack.

jobTypes.name: Burial vault — funeral home / installer wholesale
jobTypes.notes: Standing supply, contract pricing. Rigid cemetery times possible.

jobTypes.name: Burial vault — family / cemetery direct
jobTypes.notes: Pre-need or at-need. Coordinate with funeral home. Payer may not be site contact.

jobTypes.name: Septic tank manufacture / sale only
jobTypes.notes: Yard pour and delivery or pickup. Manufacturer # may later feed a CEP-5 if the same company also installs.

jobTypes.name: OSS repair / replacement
jobTypes.requiresPermit: CEP-2 repair permit unless CEP-5A waiver applies
mayAlsoNeed: CEP-5A waiver (CEP-5 still required; no LHD inspection / no Approval for Use)

jobTypes.name: OSS install or repair outside Alabama
jobTypes.notes: Different close-out. Do not show CEP-5. Form pack deferred.

jobTypes.name: Septic pumping / pump-out
jobTypes.notes: Licensed pumper (CEP-1 is a pumper permit, not a per-job form in v1). Return visits.

jobTypes.name: Other septic maintenance / diagnostic
jobTypes.notes: Becomes oss_repair if they open a repair that needs certification.
